[1] ws:app/Save/SaveGameService.cs:61-75  (method)

```
    /// <summary>CRC-32 of the payload, stored in the header.</summary>
    public static uint Checksum(ReadOnlySpan<byte> data)
    {
        uint crc = 0xFFFFFFFFu;
        foreach (byte value in data)
        {
            crc ^= value;
            for (int bit = 0; bit < 8; bit++)
            {
                crc = (crc & 1u) != 0 ? 0xEDB88320u ^ (crc >> 1) : crc >> 1;
            }
        }
        return crc ^ 0xFFFFFFFFu;
    }
}
```

[2] ws:app/Save/SaveGameService.cs:21-40  (method)
scope: Kestrel.App.Save.SaveGameService
```
    /// <summary>
    /// Saves a slot without ever leaving a half-written file behind: the
    /// data goes to a temporary file first and replaces the real one only
    /// after it is complete.
    /// </summary>
    public async Task SaveAsync(string slot, byte[] payload)
    {
        string finalPath = Path.Combine(_root, slot + ".sav");
        string tempPath = finalPath + ".tmp";
        await using (var stream = new FileStream(tempPath, FileMode.Create))
        await using (var writer = new BinaryWriter(stream))
        {
            writer.Write(Magic);
            writer.Write(FormatVersion);
            writer.Write(payload.Length);
            writer.Write(Checksum(payload));
            writer.Write(payload);
        }
        File.Move(tempPath, finalPath, overwrite: true);
    }
```

[3] ws:app/Save/SaveGameService.cs:42-59  (method)
scope: Kestrel.App.Save.SaveGameService
```
    /// <summary>Loads a slot, or returns null when it is damaged.</summary>
    public byte[]? Load(string slot)
    {
        string path = Path.Combine(_root, slot + ".sav");
        if (!File.Exists(path))
        {
            return null;
        }
        using var reader = new BinaryReader(File.OpenRead(path));
        if (reader.ReadUInt32() != Magic || reader.ReadInt32() > FormatVersion)
        {
            return null;
        }
        int length = reader.ReadInt32();
        uint expected = reader.ReadUInt32();
        byte[] payload = reader.ReadBytes(length);
        return Checksum(payload) == expected ? payload : null;
    }
```

```
// Kestrel sample app (synthetic test fixture, not a real product).
using System;
using System.IO;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace Kestrel.App.Save;

/// <summary>Writes and reads save slots on disk.</summary>
public sealed class SaveGameService
{
    private const uint Magic = 0x4B53_4156; // "KSAV"
    private const int FormatVersion = 3;
    private readonly string _root;

    public SaveGameService(string root)
    {
        _root = root;
        Directory.CreateDirectory(_root);
    }
```

[5] ws:engine/Core/Hash.cpp:26-40  (function)
scope: kes::core
```
    //! CRC-32 (IEEE 802.3, reflected polynomial 0xEDB88320) of a byte range.
    //! Used to detect corrupted asset packs when they are mounted.
    uint32_t Crc32(const uint8_t* data, size_t size)
    {
        if (!g_crcTableReady)
        {
            BuildCrcTable();
        }
        uint32_t crc = 0xFFFFFFFFu;
        for (size_t i = 0; i < size; ++i)
        {
            crc = g_crcTable[(crc ^ data[i]) & 0xFFu] ^ (crc >> 8);
        }
        return crc ^ 0xFFFFFFFFu;
    }
```

[6] ws:docs/save-data.md:27-31  (heading)
scope: セーブデータの設計
```
## 入力の割り当て

キーの割り当ては、セーブデータとは別の設定ファイルに保存する。設定は
起動時に 1 回だけ読み込み、変更したときにすぐ書き戻す。ほかの操作が
同じキーを使っていたら、2 つの操作のキーを入れ替える。
```

[7] ws:docs/save-data.md:20-25  (heading)
scope: セーブデータの設計
```
## 書き込みの手順

書き込みの途中で電源が切れても、前のセーブデータを失わないようにする。
そのために、まず一時ファイルに全部を書き、書き終えてから、本来の
ファイルと置き換える。置き換えは 1 回の操作で済むので、中途半端な
ファイルが残ることはない。
```

[8] ws:docs/jobs.md:1-10  (heading)
```
# Job system notes

Synthetic test fixture for context-foundation. It describes a made-up
sample engine and is not documentation of a real product.

## Queues

Each worker thread owns a queue. A worker pushes and pops its own work at
one end of its queue, which keeps related work on the same core and its
data in that core's cache.
```
